plan: Keep authored recipe immutable: copy every dict/list before editing; print_original returns authored_text unchanged, byte-for-byte.
Compute a single Fraction scale factor target_yield / recipe yield and apply it to every quantity, including catalog-introduced additional ingredients.
Index the catalog by 'for' name, sorted by (priority, catalog position) for deterministic lowest-priority-wins selection with catalog-order tie-break.

Resolve each ingredient with a while-excluded substitution loop plus a frozenset chain of visited names for cycle detection; feed additional ingredients back into a worklist carrying the chain, enabling chained adaptations and detection of reintroduced exclusions.

Accumulate reasons and warnings in sets without aborting, so every independently applicable reason (no substitution, unavailable equipment, cycle) is reported together, sorted; recipe is null when any reason exists.

Accumulate wording changes, equipment adds/removals, and yield factors as ordered ledgers; replay wording over instruction strings, emit sorted equipment checked against availability, and renormalize quantities with a warning if substitutions altered yield.
Embed the seven acceptance scenarios as executable asserts under __main__.
mechanisms: copy-on-read input immutability (dict/list copies, deepcopy for components)
uniform Fraction scale factor applied to all quantities
worklist ingredient resolution with per-path frozenset visited chain for cycle detection
chain propagation to additional ingredients for chained substitution and reintroduced-exclusion detection
set-accumulated reasons/warnings with sorted emission and skip-and-continue error collection
ordered effect ledgers replayed at the end for wording changes, equipment deltas, and yield renormalization
